overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. The Board's in-person access at an open, accessible location satisfied the law even though the listed Zoom link failed, and the AG encouraged multiple access means without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Board failed to provide adequate alternative public access to its July 12 meeting when the Zoom link listed on the notice did not work.
